objective: Collect three distinct manual paired observations within one live NSE session, then complete one lightweight next-session rollover validation before any decision to retire routine screenshots or activate production structured-data runtime.
notes: Each validation run begins only after explicit user approval such as RUN NOW.
The structured snapshot freezes immediately after approval; the screenshot-assisted reference may differ slightly in timestamp.
A pair is comparable when both records share the same manual run id/session and their evidence timestamps differ by no more than 300 seconds.
Pairs within 180 seconds are preferred; larger deltas up to 300 seconds remain comparable-with-tolerance and retain the measured time delta.
Three distinct comparable manual run ids in one NSE session are sufficient for the primary G11 migration review.
The separate next-session rollover check validates stale prior-day rejection, date/session rollover and new-session identity; it is not a fourth full paired run.
REVIEW_READY is not a PASS verdict, screenshot-retirement decision, production activation decision, or methodology change.
No numeric market-output discrepancy threshold is invented in this execution-layer experiment; deltas are reported for governed review.
PR #30 remains draft and unmerged until explicit production integration approval.
